question: Which country finished at the top of the medal table at the inaugural **World Yogasana Championships** held in **Ahmedabad** in June 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India** dominated the inaugural **World Yogasana Championships**, which concluded in **Ahmedabad, Gujarat**, on June 8, 2026.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** finished first in the medal standings with a total of **114 medals**, including an impressive **102 gold medals**.
 
• **Japan** secured the second position on the medal table, finishing with **three gold**, three silver, and five bronze medals.
 
• **Argentina** took the third spot, primarily through the performance of **Nabila Barraza**, who won two gold and three silver medals.
 
• **Nepal** finished fifth in the standings but was the **second-most successful** country in terms of **total medals won** (52 medals).
 
• **Uzbekistan** secured the fourth spot mentioned in the tally with 25 medals (one gold, 13 silver, and 11 bronze).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• A total of **522 athletes** from **79 countries** participated in the championships.
 
• Out of the 79 participating nations, **31 countries** won at least one medal, while **10 nations** managed to claim at least one gold medal.
 
• The Indian contingent comprised **122 members** competing across **six age categories**, from Sub-Junior (10-14 years) to Senior C (45-55 years).

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The event was supported by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports**, **Ministry of Ayush**, and the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)**.
 
• The championships serve as a significant step toward establishing **Yogasana** as a competitive international sport and advancing its push for **Olympic recognition**.
